title: Analysis pipeline for "Protein abundance modulates the structural localization of continuous-time quantum walks on mitochondrial pathway networks"
description:
Jupyter notebooks and derived result tables implementing a continuous-time quantum walk analysis of the MitoCarta 3.0 mitochondrial pathway network, weighted by tissue-resolved mass-spectrometric protein abundance, together with permutation-based inference, robustness analyses and a benchmark against eight non-quantum comparators.

This deposit accompanies an article submitted to Discover Applied Sciences. Executing the notebook end to end regenerates every figure, table and statistic reported in the article under a fixed random seed. The source data are not redistributed: the Human MitoCarta 3.0 inventory must be downloaded from the Broad Institute, and the notebook verifies its SHA-256 checksum at run time.
